description: Lists the connected account's private chat conversations, newest activity first: one entry per thread with `room_id`, the other party (`with_user_t2`, `with_username`, `with_membership`), the latest message preview and `unread_count`. Paged: up to `limit` threads per call and an `after` cursor (null on the last page); `total_threads` counts every conversation. `listing_status` is complete, or unknown when Reddit would not list them all. Reads as the connected (stored) session. Billed at the DM read rate per page.

after.description: The previous response's `after` cursor, exactly as returned. Absent on the first page.

name: reddit_dm_threads
title: List DM Threads
